subject: Characters prohibited from use in text-words in COPY … REPLACING and REPLACE statements
notes: kb/Work PB1543 (w67m): the determination (no character is prohibited in a text-word; only the COBOL space, tab and line end separate) is now what the compiler does — TextWordScanner.IsSeparatorSpace (the lexer's WS set) replaced char.IsWhiteSpace at every text-word boundary (TryNext, SeparatorFollows, EndsCharacterString) and at the 7.2.3.3 SR2 'preceded by a space' test; U+00A0 / U+2003 / U+3000 are text-word characters (cite.py OK 8.3.5 1), 7.2.2.5 3)).
